messages:
Lia Chen: FYI — AcmeCorp legal asked for a permanently pinned route to our low-latency inference pool and an audit trail proving requests were routed there. Asking for input on policy + UI/telemetry needs.
Samir Patel: do we have an existing 'pin-to-pool' mechanism? iirc we have header-driven sticky routing but it's temporary.
Ashok Rao: correct — we do tenant-header affinity but it's not surfaced in Console and there's no admin audit event for the pin action.
Maria Gomez: two separate asks: (1) allow per-customer persistent route (2) immutable audit entries showing who changed it and when. both need admin UX + API.
Lia Chen: i think AcmeCorp expects this to be an enterprise exception (SLA), not a transient override. they want it to survive redeploys and autoscaling.
Pranav Iyer: from infra side: permanent pins must be in the routing control plane, not ephemeral proxies. we need a DB-backed rule with versioning + fallback policy if low-latency pool capacity is exceeded.
kevin: capacity fallback is critical — failure mode should auto-fall back to best-effort pool and emit a routed_event with reason=capacity. no silent failures.
Ashok Rao: agreed. also need to capture the original org header+signature in audit logs. security wants the pin change recorded with requestor id + JIRA ticket.
Maria Gomez: sketch of API: POST /admin/orgs/:org_id/routing-pins {"pool":"low-latency","reason":"contract","expires_at":null} returns 200 + audit_id. we should allow expires_at=null for permanent.
Lia Chen: looks good. can we include a small example for the routing engine?
Samir Patel: example policy snippet: 
```
{
  "org_id": "acme-123",
  "match": {"header":"x-org-id"},
  "action": {"type":"pin","destination":"low-latency-pool","priority":100},
  "audit_id": "audit_20240305_01"
}
```
Pranav Iyer: implementation notes: add DB table routing_pins(org_id, pool, priority, created_by, created_ts, expires_at, audit_id, manifest). manifests help for rollbacks.
audit-bot: New audit entry created: audit_20240305_01 by Lia Chen for org acme-123 (reason: contract). Link: https://redwood.internal/audit/audit_20240305_01
kevin: Console changes: add new 'Pinned routes' card under Org settings showing active pins + who created them + an 'unpin' button that opens confirmation modal requiring 2FA for enterprise orgs. also surface health of pinned pool (util %, queued requests).
Maria Gomez: UX: add 'Impact preview' before apply showing expected latency delta and fallback behavior. generate a temporary canary for 1% traffic? or just simulate routing for a sample of recent request traces.
Ashok Rao: telemetry: we need routed_event with fields [org_id, audit_id, route_destination, route_reason, route_decision, fallback_reason, latency_ms, tokens]. increment metric org_pinned_route_hits{pool} and emit alert if fallback_rate > 3% over 5m.
Samir Patel: rollout plan: behind feature flag + admin-only API. run for 1-2 pilot customers (AcmeCorp + Nimbus) then GA. create migration to backfill pins from existing tenant-header affinity rules (if any).
Lia Chen: can someone own a short RFC? I can pair on it. Ashok/Pranav volunteer?
Pranav Iyer: I'll draft the infra section and DB schema. Ashok will do telemetry + audit format. Samir can do API shape + gateway changes.
Maria Gomez: I'll mock the Console screens and copy. schedule a sync with Security to confirm audit retention and KMS fields.
Lia Chen: thanks team. created ticket ENG-4521 and assigned owners. tagging #security-team for visibility.
kevin: added a pointer to the capacity playbook and notes about auto-fallback policies in ENG-4521.
Lia Chen: closing loop — will update AcmeCorp that we have a plan and timeline (pilot in 2 weeks).
